req.title: Reject negative squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-023 requires HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer. The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP — the rule requires that negative-kind tests use heuristic=NEG, not EP. Fix: change test[5] heuristic from EP to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid positive squadNumber yields 201; (2) negative NEG — clearly negative squadNumber (-5) yields 422; (3) boundary BVA — squadNumber=0 yields 422; (4) boundary BVA — squadNumber=1 yields 409 (proves validation passed); (5) boundary BVA — squadNumber=-1 yields 422; (6) negative NEG — squadNumber=-999 yields 422 (representative of negative equivalence class, heuristic corrected to NEG).

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 does not exist in the fixture data
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload where squadNumber=99 (a positive integer not in the fixture)
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 99
trace: R-PLAYER-023: positive integer squadNumber must be accepted (HTTP 2xx)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_one_returns_409_not_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 1 already exists in the fixture (Franco Armani)
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=1 (smallest positive integer, boundary+1 from 0)
Expect 409 Conflict because squad number 1 already exists — confirming the value passed validation (not 422)
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict is returned (not 422), proving squadNumber=1 passed Pydantic validation
trace: R-PLAYER-023: squadNumber=1 is the smallest positive integer and must pass validation (not 422)
BVA: boundary+1 from 0; 409 proves validation passed, distinguishing from 422
